Container.Name: dead-movies-shows
Container.Overview:
Identify movies and shows in Sonarr/Radarr that nobody (or nobody who requested them) has watched. Joins Sonarr/Radarr inventory with Tautulli watch history and Overseerr/Seerr request data, then ranks reclaim candidates by size, age, and last-played date.
Private app — no telemetry, no external services beyond your own *arr stack and Plex/Tautulli.
First run setup: 1. Generate a bcrypt password hash: docker exec dead-movies-shows python -m dms.cli.hash_password 2. Generate a session secret: openssl rand -base64 32 3. Paste both into the template form (APP_PASSWORD_HASH, SESSION_SECRET). 4. Fill in your Sonarr/Radarr/Tautulli/Overseerr URLs + API keys (one slot per instance). 5. Save and start. Open the WebUI, sign in, click "Sync now" on /sync.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port to expose the web UI on. Container port is fixed at 8765.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent state — SQLite DB and any future cached files. Required.

Config.Name: App username
Config.Description: Username you'll log in with.

Config.Name: App password (bcrypt hash)
Config.Description: Generate via: docker exec dead-movies-shows python -m dms.cli.hash_password

Config.Name: Session secret
Config.Description: Random 32+ char string. Generate via: openssl rand -base64 32

Config.Name: Cookie Secure flag
Config.Description: Set to true if you ONLY access via HTTPS (e.g. tunnel-only). false works for both LAN HTTP and HTTPS proxy.

Config.Name: Session lifetime (days)
Config.Description: How long a login session lasts before requiring re-auth.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID to run as. 99 = nobody on Unraid.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID to run as. 100 = users on Unraid.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: IANA timezone, e.g. America/Toronto, America/Vancouver, Europe/London.

Config.Name: Sync cron
Config.Description: Cron expression for scheduled sync. Default = 04:00 daily in your TZ.

Config.Name: Watch scope (default view)
Config.Description: anyone | requester. The dashboard has a per-page toggle; this is the default.

Config.Name: Movies watch threshold (%)
Config.Description: A movie counts as watched once a viewer reaches this % of completion.

Config.Name: Episodes watch threshold (%)
Config.Description: An episode counts as watched once a viewer reaches this % of completion.

Config.Name: Specials handling
Config.Description: ignore | include. Whether season-0 specials count toward 'show finished'.

Config.Name: Never-watched threshold (days)
Config.Description: Days since added before an unwatched item is flagged as a candidate.

Config.Name: Stale threshold (days)
Config.Description: Days since last play before a watched item is flagged stale.

Config.Name: History retention (years)
Config.Description: Cap on locally-mirrored Tautulli history.

Config.Name: Sync HTTP timeout (s)
Config.Description: Per-request HTTP timeout when calling upstream services.

Config.Name: Sync max concurrency
Config.Description: Max parallel HTTP requests during sync.

Config.Name: Backfill page size
Config.Description: Tautulli history pull page size.

Config.Name: Sync lock TTL (minutes)
Config.Description: If a sync's heartbeat hasn't updated in this many minutes, the lock is stealable.

Config.Name: Sonarr 1 — display name
Config.Description: Friendly name shown in the UI.

Config.Name: Sonarr 1 — URL
Config.Description: Full URL incl. port. Use the LAN IP, not localhost.

Config.Name: Sonarr 1 — API key
Config.Description: Sonarr → Settings → General → API Key.

Config.Name: Sonarr 2 — display name
Config.Description: Optional second Sonarr instance (e.g. 4K).

Config.Name: Sonarr 2 — URL
Config.Description: Leave blank if you only have one Sonarr instance.

Config.Name: Radarr 1 — display name
Config.Description: Friendly name shown in the UI.

Config.Name: Radarr 1 — URL
Config.Description: Full URL incl. port. Use the LAN IP, not localhost.

Config.Name: Radarr 1 — API key
Config.Description: Radarr → Settings → General → API Key.

Config.Name: Radarr 2 — display name
Config.Description: Optional second Radarr instance (e.g. 4K).

Config.Name: Radarr 2 — URL
Config.Description: Leave blank if you only have one Radarr instance.

Config.Name: Tautulli — URL
Config.Description: Tautulli web URL. Required if you want watch history.

Config.Name: Tautulli — API key
Config.Description: Tautulli → Settings → Web Interface → API.

Config.Name: Requester 1 — source
Config.Description: overseerr | seerr | jellyseerr | none

Config.Name: Requester 1 — display name
Config.Description: Friendly name shown in the UI.

Config.Name: Requester 1 — URL
Config.Description: Full URL incl. port.

Config.Name: Requester 1 — API key
Config.Description: Overseerr/Seerr → Settings → General → API Key.

Config.Name: Requester 2 — source
Config.Description: Optional second requester instance (e.g. for 4K, or during Overseerr → Seerr migration).
